name: Coined quantum walk: 7 steps on a cycle of 16 positions in Cirq
task_prompt: Implement a 7-step coined quantum walk on a cycle of 16 positions in Cirq using one coin qubit and 4 position qubits. Represent the controlled modular shift by a validated permutation MatrixGate with a clearly defined tensor-bit order, compute the exact position marginal, and cross-check it against a separately constructed NumPy step matrix. Assert both distributions are normalized and agree within 1e-12. Respond with a single runnable Python file and no prose outside the code. The program must be CPU-runnable, deterministic where practical, and fail loudly through assertions when a requested property is not met.
